title: Multilevel Community-Centered Intervention to Reduce Pregnancy Related and Associated Morbidity and Mortality (PRAMM) Disparities
official: Multilevel Community-centered Intervention to Reduce Pregnancy Related and Associated Morbidity and Mortality (PRAMM) Disparities in Non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic Medicaid-insured Individuals
summary: The goal of the study involving human subjects is to train providers to address patient-provider interactions. The study will survey providers to assess pre-post knowledge, understanding, and behavior changes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Providing care to pregnant and postpartum women in Wayne, Kent, and Genesee Counties in MI

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
